label: Dysphagia / IDDSI texture (STUB — not yet implemented)
clinical_basis: Frozen desserts are transitional (solid-to-liquid) foods, which is exactly why IDDSI texture control matters for dysphagia. Full texture-modification logic (flow rate, fork-drip, transitional-food handling) is out of scope for this phase.
notes: This ruleset defines the module shape so a full IDDSI evaluator can slot in with zero core changes. The stub evaluator emits a single warn-level advisory and never fails a formula.
